limitations: Species identifications are results with variable taxonomic resolution; Castor canadensis is a database surrogate for archaeological Castor, so genus is used.
Age and sex of the source animals are not reported.
Mass tolerances are omitted because the exact final search settings were not independently verified from deposited search files.
